rawContent: I was born when it was "women's lib," and one thinks feminism is not going away, I hope not, but during all these decades between and during the #MeToo movement we all have learned to say and accept expressions like "Putin's bitch" and that is at least as bad as any other words.
I'll never get over it, the gaslighting level. Trump is in the White House and Senate Dems have a #metoo movement for Jews who joke about it, Trump is pres, "zero tolerance" policy for Jews
